subject: POC readiness canvas: milestone owners & acceptance runway
messages:
From: Jordan Singh <j.singh@alliedhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@alliedhealth.com>, procurement@alliedhealth.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — alignment and timeline

Hi Irene / Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed on the call, leadership wants a short weekly check-in while we run the POC to keep the MAP tight and make sure we hit the acceptance gates by the end of Q1.

Quick asks for this week: can you confirm the owner for the integration milestone (SFTP ingest + anonymization) and whether the SOC2 evidence package you mentioned will be attached to the MAP? We have an internal dependency on our security team finishing their review by 12/10.

Attached is our internal timeline snapshot — we'll need the Redwood acceptance criteria to line up with our Test Plan. Please advise on blockers you see.

Cheers,
Jordan
Director, Data Platform
Allied Health

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Singh <j.singh@alliedhealth.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@alliedhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — alignment and timeline

Jordan — thanks for the clear asks. Short update and proposed owners below. I'll run the weekly MAP checkpoint notes and publish an updated MAP_v2.xlsx to the Drive link once we confirm action owners.

Summary (this email will be our record for today's checkpoint):
- Integration milestone (SFTP ingest + anonymization): owner = Karthik Iyer (engineering lead)
- SOC2 evidence for POC: Redwood will share a redacted summary this week (Vanessa to lead) — full pack available under NDA/Procurement channel
- Acceptance criteria doc: attached (POC-acceptance-criteria.md) with suggested pass/fail gates aligned to your Test Plan

Immediate blockers we see:
1) Sample data export format — Allied must provide a consistent sample by 12/03 (Priya). If that slips, data ingest will push integration into week-of-12/13.
2) Procurement request for a limited DPA amendment — procurement touchpoint (Allied) needs to confirm by 12/08 to allow SOC2 evidence exchange.

Actions (owners & ETA):
- Karthik: confirm SFTP schema and generate ingest adapter by 12/07 (owner: Karthik Iyer)
- Vanessa: compile SOC2 summary and share with Priya by 12/04 (owner: Vanessa Ortiz)
- Irene: update MAP spreadsheet, publish to Drive, and schedule weekly checkpoint calls (owner: Irene Choi) — first checkpoint Wed 12/02 10:00am PT

Please reply with any changes; if Priya can supply the sample by EOD Thursday (12/03) we should be on track.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC-acceptance-criteria.md
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Singh <j.singh@alliedhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 08:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — integration owner and adapter plan

+1 to Irene's plan. Quick technical notes so Allied's engineers can validate the sample: 
- Expected sample: newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) with a consistent patient_id hash field, timestamp (ISO8601), and payload fields (text, metadata).
- We will perform client-side anonymization on ingest if we detect PII patterns outside of the hashed id — this will be configurable but defaulted to remove free-text name/email patterns.
- I will drop a small adapter repo and a sample schema tomorrow (12/02) into the Drive link; ETA for ingest adapter to run in our staging environment is 12/07.

Known risks:
- If Allied's sample includes nested binary blobs (DICOM, attachments), adapter effort increases — please call this out ASAP.

Action updates:
- Karthik: will upload schema + adapter stub to Drive by 12/02 (owner: Karthik Iyer)
- Vanessa: will share SOC2 summary by 12/04 (owner: Vanessa Ortiz)
- Irene: calendar invite being sent for 12/02 checkpoint; will include meeting agenda and desired outputs

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Lead, Integrations — Redwood Inference
From: Priya Menon <priya.m@alliedhealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Singh <j.singh@alliedhealth.com>, procurement@alliedhealth.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC readiness canvas: milestone owners & acceptance runway

Thanks everyone — confirm we will:
- Provide ndjson sample (no DICOM) by 12/03 EOD.
- Procurement will review DPA amendment language and respond by 12/08.

Two quick asks from Allied: 
1) Can Redwood provide a short checklist of items you require from our security team to accelerate the SOC2 review? A one-page checklist would help.
2) Can we add a short subtask in the MAP for performance baseline (50 concurrent sample requests) — we want that to be a soft acceptance gate before signing off on data flow.

Priya
Senior Program Manager
Allied Health
